title: Other Insurer's Payment Taken Off a TRICARE Select Line Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Rule.** On a **TRICARE Select** outpatient line reprocessed for other health insurance, where other health insurance is on file and the other insurer paid some but less than the allowed amount, the other insurer's payment is taken off before a line reprocessed for other health insurance is cost-shared; where other health insurance is on file and the other insurer paid at least the allowed amount, the whole allowed amount is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off. What is taken off comes off the allowed amount, and the line is cost-shared on what remains.

The other insurer's payment is the one recorded on the reversed line; whether other health insurance is on file is shown on the enrollee's Select enrollment.

## Points of judgement

**The other insurer paid part of the allowed amount.** Its payment is taken off: on an allowed amount of 300.00 with 120.00 paid, the line is cost-shared on 180.00.

**The other insurer paid the whole allowed amount or more.** The whole allowed amount is taken off: with 300.00 or 350.00 paid on 300.00 allowed, nothing remains to cost-share.

**Other health insurance is not on file, or the other insurer paid nothing.** Nothing is taken off; the line is cost-shared on the full allowed amount.

## Boundary (hypothetical, allowed amount 300.00, other health insurance on file)

| Other insurer paid | Taken off | Cost-shared on |
|---|---|---|
| 299.99 | 299.99 | 0.01 |
| 300.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 300.00 |
